name: chartlink
description: Charts and tables with live-updating embed links, made from one message. Connects the chartlink MCP server and teaches the create → preview → publish loop.

api_key.title: chartlink API key
api_key.description: Starts with viz_. Don't have one? Ask Claude to "set up chartlink": the skill calls POST https://chartlink.app/api/signup (no account needed) and shows you the key to paste here.
